intro.en: A worried mother talks to her sister about her son Sami, who is fifteen. Notice the commands: افْعَلْ (do!) and لا تَفْعَلْ (don't!).
intro.ur: Ek pareshan maa apni behan se apne bete Sami ke bare mein baat karti hai jo pandrah saal ka hai. Hukm افْعَلْ (karo!) aur mumaniat لا تَفْعَلْ (mat karo!) par ghaur karein.
intro.ar: أُمٌّ خائِفَةٌ تَتَحَدَّثُ إِلى أُخْتِها عَنِ اِبْنِها سامي الَّذي بَلَغَ الخامِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ. لاحِظْ فِعْلَ الأَمْرِ «اِفْعَلْ» وَالنَّهْيَ «لا تَفْعَلْ».

dialogue.ar: أَنا خائِفَةٌ عَلى اِبْني سامي؛ فَقَدْ صارَ يَعودُ مِنَ المَدْرَسَةِ مُتَأَخِّراً وَلا يَقولُ لِماذا.
dialogue.tr: anā khāʾifatun ʿalā ibnī sāmī; faqad ṣāra yaʿūdu mina l-madrasati mutaʾakhkhiran walā yaqūlu limādhā.
dialogue.en: I am afraid for my son Sami; he has started coming home from school late and does not say why.
dialogue.ur: Mujhe apne bete Sami ke bare mein dar hai; woh school se der se aane laga hai aur wajah nahin batata.

dialogue.ar: وَإِذا سَأَلْتُهُ عَنْ أَصْدِقائِهِ سَكَتَ، وَلا يُريدُ أَنْ يُحَدِّثَني.
dialogue.tr: waʾidhā saʾaltuhu ʿan aṣdiqāʾihi sakat, walā yurīdu an yuḥaddithanī.
dialogue.en: And if I ask him about his friends he goes silent and does not want to talk to me.
dialogue.ur: Aur agar main us se doston ke bare mein poochun to khamosh ho jata hai aur mujh se baat nahin karna chahta.

dialogue.ar: بَلَغَ سامي الخامِسَةَ عَشْرَةَ مِنْ عُمُرِهِ، وَقَلَقُكِ عَلَيْهِ طَبيعِيٌّ يا أُخْتي.
dialogue.tr: balagha sāmī l-khāmisata ʿashrata min ʿumurih, waqalaquki ʿalayhi ṭabīʿiyyun yā ukhtī.
dialogue.en: This is a natural feeling, my sister, but Sami has reached the age of fifteen.
dialogue.ur: Yeh qudrati ehsaas hai meri behan, lekin Sami pandrah baras ka ho chuka hai.

dialogue.ar: اِنْتَبِهي، فَهذِهِ مَرْحَلَةُ المُراهَقَةِ، وَهِيَ تَحْتاجُ مِنْكِ إِلى حِكْمَةٍ في المُعامَلَة.
dialogue.tr: intabihī, fahdhihi marḥalatu l-murāhaqah, wahiya taḥtāju minki ilā ḥikmatin fī l-muʿāmalah.
dialogue.en: He is in the teenage stage now, so treat him with wisdom.
dialogue.ur: Woh ab nojawani ke daur mein hai, is liye us ke saath hikmat se pesh aayein.

dialogue.ar: وَكَيْفَ أَفْعَلُ ذلِك؟
dialogue.tr: wakayfa afʿalu dhālik?
dialogue.en: And how do I do that?
dialogue.ur: Aur main yeh kaise karun?

dialogue.ar: يَرى سامي نَفْسَهُ كَبيراً، وَيَعْرِفُ أَنَّ بَعْضَ الأُمورِ تَنْفَعُهُ وَبَعْضَها يَضُرُّه.
dialogue.tr: yarā sāmī nafsahu kabīran, wayaʿrifu anna baʿḍa l-umūri tanfaʿuhu wabaʿḍahā yaḍurruh.
dialogue.en: Sami feels he has grown up, and he knows what benefits him and what harms him.
dialogue.ur: Sami mehsoos karta hai ke woh bada ho gaya hai, aur woh jaanta hai ke kya us ke liye faida mand hai aur kya nuqsan deh.

dialogue.ar: أَعْتَرِفُ بِأَنَّني أُعامِلُهُ كَالصَّغيرِ: اِفْعَلْ هذا، وَلا تَفْعَلْ ذلِك.
dialogue.tr: aʿtarifu biʾannanī uʿāmiluhu kālṣṣaghīr: ifʿal hādhā, walā tafʿal dhālik.
dialogue.en: I admit that I treat him like a little boy: do this, and do not do that.
dialogue.ur: Main maanti hoon ke main us ke saath chhote bachche jaisa sulook karti hoon: yeh karo, woh mat karo.

dialogue.ar: هذا أُسْلوبٌ غَيْرُ سَليم، وَقَدْ يُبْعِدُهُ عَنْكِ.
dialogue.tr: hādhā uslūbun ghayru salīm, waqad yubʿiduhu ʿank.
dialogue.en: This is an unsound approach, and it may push him away from you.
dialogue.ur: Yeh durust tareeqa nahin, aur ho sakta hai yeh use aap se door kar de.

dialogue.ar: تَحاوَري مَعَهُ، وَاحْتَرِمي آراءَهُ، وَسَيَقْتَرِبُ مِنْكِ مِنْ جَديد.
dialogue.tr: taḥāwarī maʿah, wāḥtarimī ʾārāʾah, wasayaqtaribu minki min jadīd.
dialogue.en: Talk things over with him, respect his opinions, and he will come close to you again.
dialogue.ur: Us se baat cheet karein, us ki raaye ka ehtiram karein, aur woh dobara aap ke qareeb aa jayega.

dialogue.ar: شُكْراً لَكِ يا أُخْتي، لَقَدْ أَراحَتْني كَلِماتُكِ.
dialogue.tr: shukran laki yā ukhtī, laqad arāḥatnī kalimātuk.
dialogue.en: Thank you, my sister; your words have comforted me.
dialogue.ur: Shukriya meri behan, aap ki baaton se mujhe sukoon mila.

q.ur: «مَرْحَلَةُ المُراهَقَة» ka matlab?

title.en: Sounds: Meeting of two identical sounds
title.ur: Awaaz: Do ek jaisi awaazon ka milna

intro.en: Rule: when two identical letters meet and the first has sukoon, they are merged and pronounced as one doubled sound (with shadda). Example: مِنْ + نَاصِرِينَ sounds like «مِنّاصِرين».
intro.ur: Qaida: jab do ek jaise huroof milen aur pehle par sukoon ho, to dono ko mila kar ek mushaddad awaaz ki tarah parhte hain. Misaal: مِنْ + نَاصِرِينَ ko «مِنّاصِرين» parha jata hai.
intro.ar: القاعِدَةُ: إِذا اِلْتَقى حَرْفانِ مُتَماثِلانِ وَكانَ الأَوَّلُ ساكِناً، يُدْغَمانِ وَيُنْطَقانِ حَرْفاً واحِداً مُشَدَّداً. مِثالٌ: «مِنْ ناصِرينَ» تُنْطَقُ «مِنّاصِرين».

q.en: When two identical letters meet and the first has sukoon, what do we do?
q.ur: Jab do ek jaise huroof milen aur pehle par sukoon ho to kya karte hain?
q.ar: إِذا اِلْتَقى حَرْفانِ مُتَماثِلانِ وَالأَوَّلُ ساكِنٌ، ماذا نَفْعَلُ؟

options: Merge them into one doubled sound

q.en: How is the merged sound pronounced?
q.ur: Mila hua harf kaise parha jata hai?

q.en: Which pair is an example of two identical letters meeting?
q.ur: Kaun si misaal do ek jaise huroof ke milne ki hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ مِثالٍ فيهِ التِقاءُ حَرْفَيْنِ مُتَماثِلَيْنِ؟

q.en: In «قَدْ دَخَلُوا» which letters merge?
q.ur: «قَدْ دَخَلُوا» mein kaun se huroof mil jate hain?

title.en: Grammar: Jussive of verbs ending in a weak letter
title.ur: Qawaid: Aakhir mein illat wale fel ka jazm

intro.en: After لَمْ, a present verb that ends in a weak letter (ا / و / ي) loses that letter and keeps the vowel before it. Example: يَسْعى becomes لَمْ يَسْعَ, and يَدْعو becomes لَمْ يَدْعُ.
intro.ur: لَمْ ke baad aisa fel mudare jis ke aakhir mein illat ka harf (ا / و / ي) ho, wo harf gir jata hai aur us se pehle ki harkat baaqi rehti hai. Misaal: يَسْعى se لَمْ يَسْعَ, aur يَدْعو se لَمْ يَدْعُ.
intro.ar: بَعْدَ «لَمْ» يَحْذِفُ الفِعْلُ المُضارِعُ المُعْتَلُّ الآخِرِ حَرْفَ العِلَّةِ وَتَبْقى الحَرَكَةُ الَّتي قَبْلَهُ. مِثالٌ: «يَسْعى» تُصْبِحُ «لَمْ يَسْعَ»، وَ«يَدْعو» تُصْبِحُ «لَمْ يَدْعُ».

q.en: What happens to the weak letter after لَمْ?
q.ur: لَمْ ke baad illat ke harf ka kya hota hai?
q.ar: ماذا يَحْدُثُ لِحَرْفِ العِلَّةِ الأَخيرِ بَعْدَ «لَمْ»؟

q.en: What is the jussive of «يَدْعو»?
q.ur: «يَدْعو» ka jazm kya hai?

q.en: What is the jussive of «يَقْضي»?
q.ur: «يَقْضي» ka jazm kya hai?

q.en: What is the jussive of «يَسْعى»?
q.ur: «يَسْعى» ka jazm kya hai?

intro.en: Listen to a dialogue and answer questions about life in the past and the problems of young people today. Then practise asking a partner questions about family and age.
intro.ur: Ek guftagu suniye aur sawalon ke jawab dijiye: guzre zamane ki zindagi aur aaj ke nojawanon ke masail. Phir apne saathi se ahl-e-khana aur umar ke baare mein sawal poochein.
intro.ar: اِسْتَمِعْ إِلى حِوارٍ عَنِ الحَياةِ قَديماً وَمُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ اليَوْمَ وَأَجِبْ. ثُمَّ تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَلى أَسْئِلَةٍ عَنِ الأُسْرَةِ وَالعُمْرِ.

vocab.ur: kya aap apne ghar walon ko batate hain?

q.ur: «مَتى تَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ؟» kya poochta hai?
q.ar: عَمّا يَسْأَلُ السُّؤالُ «مَتى تَخْرُجُ مِنَ البَيْتِ؟»

options: When do you leave the house?

intro.en: A reading passage about youth as the most important stage of life, the time of giving and working. It mentions young Companions who were given great responsibility.
intro.ur: Ek parhne ka matn: jawani insaan ki zindagi ka sab se ahm daur hai, dene aur kaam karne ka waqt. Is mein Sahaba ke jawanon ka zikr hai jinhein bari zimmedariyan di gayin.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنِ الشَّبابِ بِوَصْفِهِ أَهَمَّ مَرْحَلَةٍ في الحَياةِ، مَرْحَلَةِ العَطاءِ وَالعَمَلِ. وَيَذْكُرُ شَباباً مِنَ الصَّحابَةِ حُمِّلوا مَسْؤولِيّاتٍ كَبيرَةً.

dialogue.ar: يَمُرُّ الإِنْسانُ بِمَراحِلَ كَثيرَةٍ، وَأَهَمُّها في نَظَرِنا مَرْحَلَةُ الشَّباب؛ فَفيها يَقْوى الجِسْمُ وَيَنْشَطُ العَقْل.
dialogue.tr: yamurru l-insānu bimarāḥila kathīrah, waʾahammuhā fī naẓarinā marḥalatu sh-shabāb; fafīhā yaqwā l-jismu wayanshaṭu l-ʿaql.
dialogue.en: A person goes through many stages, and the most important in our view is the stage of youth; in it the body grows strong and the mind becomes active.
dialogue.ur: Insan kai marhaloon se guzarta hai, aur hamari nazar mein sab se ahem jawani ka daur hai; is mein jism mazboot aur zehn chust hota hai.

dialogue.ar: وَهِيَ وَقْتُ العَطاءِ وَالجِدّ، فَمَنْ بَذَلَ جُهْدَهُ في شَبابِهِ حَصَدَ ثَمَرَةَ ذلِكَ في كِبَرِه.
dialogue.tr: wahiya waqtu l-ʿaṭāʾi wāljidd, faman badhala juhdahu fī shabābihi ḥaṣada thamarata dhālik fī kibarih.
dialogue.en: It is the time of giving and seriousness; whoever puts in effort in his youth reaps the fruit of it in his old age.
dialogue.ur: Yeh ata aur sanjeedgi ka waqt hai; jis ne jawani mein mehnat ki us ka phal budhape mein paaya.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ حَمَلَ شَبابُ المُهاجِرينَ وَالأَنْصارِ مَسْؤولِيّاتٍ عَظيمَةً في عَهْدِ الرَّسولِ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: waqad ḥamala shabābu l-muhājirīna wālʾanṣāri masʾūliyyātin ʿaẓīmatan fī ʿahdi r-rasūli ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam.
dialogue.en: The young men among the Emigrants and the Helpers carried great responsibilities in the time of the Messenger ﷺ.
dialogue.ur: Muhajireen aur Ansar ke nojawanon ne Rasool ﷺ ke zamane mein bari zimmedariyan uthain.

dialogue.ar: وَقَدْ كانَ زَيْدُ بْنُ حارِثَةَ أَميرَ جَيْشِ المُسْلِمينَ في مُؤْتَةَ بِأَمْرِ النَّبِيِّ ﷺ.
dialogue.tr: waqad kāna zaydu bnu ḥārithata amīra jayshi l-muslimīna fī muʾtata biʾamri n-nabiyyi ṣallā llāhu ʿalayhi wa-sallam.
dialogue.en: The Prophet ﷺ made Zayd ibn Haritha the commander of the army at Mu'ta.
dialogue.ur: Nabi ﷺ ne Zayd bin Haritha ko Mu'ta mein lashkar ka sipah-salar banaya.

dialogue.ar: وَجَعَلَ أُسامَةَ بْنَ زَيْدٍ أَميرَ الجَيْشِ الإِسْلامِيِّ في مُواجَهَةِ الرّومِ، وَلَمْ يَكُنْ قَدْ تَجاوَزَ الثّامِنَةَ عَشْرَةَ.
dialogue.tr: wajaʿala usāmata bna zaydin amīra l-jayshi l-islāmiyyi fī mūjahati r-rūm, walam yakun qad tajāwaza th-thāminata ʿashrah.
dialogue.en: And he chose Usama ibn Zayd to lead the Islamic army against the Romans when he was eighteen years old.
dialogue.ur: Aur Usama bin Zayd ko chuna ke woh Islami lashkar ki Romiyon ke khilaf qiyadat karein, jab woh atharah baras ke the.

dialogue.ar: وَأَرْسَلَ مُعاذَ بْنَ جَبَلٍ إِلَى اليَمَنِ مُعَلِّماً وَقاضِياً، وَكانَ شابّاً أَيْضاً.
dialogue.tr: waʾarsala muʿādha bna jabalin ilā l-yamani muʿalliman waqāḍīan, wakāna shābban ayḍan.
dialogue.en: He also sent Muadh ibn Jabal to Yemen as a teacher and judge, and he too was a young man.
dialogue.ur: Aur Muaz bin Jabal ko Yaman bheja ustaad aur qazi bana kar, aur woh bhi nojawan the.

dialogue.ar: وَالأُمَّةُ الَّتي تَبْحَثُ عَنِ التَّقَدُّمِ تَنْتَظِرُ شَبابَها الأَقْوِياءَ الجادّينَ، وَلا تُريدُ الشّابَّ الكَسْلان.
dialogue.tr: wālʾummatu illatī tabḥathu ʿani t-taqaddumi tantaẓiru shabābahā l-aqwīʾa l-jāddīn, walā turīdu sh-shābba l-kaslān.
dialogue.en: A nation that seeks progress waits for its strong, serious young people, and does not want the lazy young man.
dialogue.ur: Taraqqi chahne wali qaum apne mazboot, sanjeeda nojawanon ka intezar karti hai, aur susst nojawan ko nahin chahti.

dialogue.ar: وَمَعَ قُوَّةِ الشَّبابِ لا بُدَّ مِنْ خِبْرَةِ الشُّيوخ، فَبِهِما مَعاً تَنْهَضُ البِلاد.
dialogue.tr: wamaʿa quwwati sh-shabābi lā budda min khibrati sh-shuyūkh, fabihimā maʿan tanhaḍu l-bilād.
dialogue.en: Along with the strength of youth, the experience of the elders is needed, for by both together the country rises.
dialogue.ur: Jawanon ki quwwat ke saath buzurgon ka tajurba bhi zaroori hai, kyunke dono se milkar mulk taraqqi karta hai.

q.en: What is the stage of youth called in the text?
q.ur: Matn mein jawani ko kya kaha gaya?

options: The most important stage in a person's life

q.en: Which type of youth does the nation need?
q.ur: Ummat ko kaisa nojawan chahiye?

q.en: What does the nation need along with the strength of youth?
q.ur: Jawani ki quwwat ke saath ummat ko kis cheez ki zaroorat hai?
q.ar: ماذا تَحْتاجُ الأُمَّةُ مَعَ قُوَّةِ الشَّبابِ؟

q.en: Who led the Islamic army against the Romans at eighteen?
q.ur: Atharah saal ki umar mein Romiyon ke khilaf lashkar ki qiyadat kis ne ki?
q.ar: مَنْ قادَ الجَيْشَ الإِسْلامِيَّ ضِدَّ الرّومِ وَهُوَ في الثّامِنَةَ عَشْرَةَ؟

q.en: Which young man was sent as a judge to Yemen?
q.ur: Kaun nojawan Yemen qazi bana kar bheja gaya?
q.ar: أَيُّ شابٍّ أُرْسِلَ قاضِياً إِلى اليَمَنِ؟

intro.en: A noun is either indefinite (نَكِرَة), pointing to something not specific, or definite (مَعْرِفَة), pointing to something specific. Example: رَجُلٌ (a man) vs الرَّجُلُ (the man).
intro.ur: Ism do qism ka hota hai: nakira (ghair muayyan cheez) aur marifa (muayyan cheez). Misaal: رَجُلٌ (koi mard) aur الرَّجُلُ (woh khaas mard).
intro.ar: الاِسْمُ إِمّا نَكِرَةٌ تَدُلُّ عَلى شَيْءٍ غَيْرِ مُعَيَّنٍ، وَإِمّا مَعْرِفَةٌ تَدُلُّ عَلى شَيْءٍ مُعَيَّنٍ. مِثالٌ: رَجُلٌ (نَكِرَةٌ) وَالرَّجُلُ (مَعْرِفَةٌ).

q.en: What does an indefinite noun (نَكِرَة) point to?
q.ur: Nakira kis cheez par dalalat karta hai?

q.en: What does a definite noun (مَعْرِفَة) point to?
q.ur: Marifa kis cheez par dalalat karta hai?

q.en: Which is definite?
q.ur: Kaun sa marifa hai?

q.en: Which is indefinite?
q.ur: Kaun sa nakira hai?

q.en: Is a personal name like «عَبْدُ الله» definite or indefinite?
q.ur: «عَبْدُ الله» jaisa naam marifa hai ya nakira?

title.ur: Mukaalma: Walidain aur aulad ka rishta

intro.en: Three friends discuss how fathers and sons, or youth and elders, should get along. They disagree politely. Useful words: أَتَّفِقُ (I agree) and أَخْتَلِفُ (I disagree).
intro.ur: Teen dost baap-beton aur nojawan-buzurgon ke rishte par baat karte hain aur adab se ikhtilaf karte hain. Kaam ke alfaaz: أَتَّفِقُ (main muttafiq hoon) aur أَخْتَلِفُ (main ikhtilaf karta hoon).
intro.ar: ثَلاثَةُ أَصْدِقاءَ يَتَناقَشونَ في العَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناءِ، وَبَيْنَ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ. يَخْتَلِفونَ بِأَدَبٍ. مِنَ الكَلِماتِ المُفيدَةِ: أَتَّفِقُ وَأَخْتَلِفُ.

dialogue.ar: أُحِبُّ أَنْ نَتَحَدَّثَ اليَوْمَ عَنِ العَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الآباءِ وَالأَبْناء؛ فَهِيَ أَساسُ الأُسْرَة.
dialogue.tr: uḥibbu an nataḥaddatha l-yawma ʿani l-ʿalāqati bayna l-ʾābāʾi wālʾabnāʾ; fahiya asāsu l-usrah.
dialogue.en: I would like us to talk today about the relationship between fathers and sons; it is the foundation of the family.
dialogue.ur: Main chahta hoon ke hum aaj walidain aur aulad ke rishte par baat karein; yeh khandan ki bunyad hai.

dialogue.ar: أَخْتَلِفُ مَعَكَ يا نَبيل؛ فَالآباءُ اليَوْمَ لا يَفْهَمونَ عَصْرَنا، وَلا فائِدَةَ مِنْ نَصائِحِهِمْ.
dialogue.tr: akhtalifu maʿaka yā nabīl; fālʾābāʾu l-yawma lā yafhamūna ʿaṣranā, walā fāʾidata min naṣāʾiḥihim.
dialogue.en: I disagree with you, Nabil; fathers today do not understand our age, and there is no use in their advice.
dialogue.ur: Main aap se ikhtilaf karta hoon Nabeel; aaj ke walid hamare daur ko nahin samajhte, aur un ki nasihaton ka koi faida nahin.

dialogue.ar: أَتَّفِقُ مَعَ نَبيل، فَالمَوْضوعُ مُهِمٌّ جِدّاً، لكِنَّني أَخْتَلِفُ مَعَ سَليم؛ فَالمُجْتَمَعُ لا يَنْهَضُ إِلّا بِقُوَّةِ الشَّبابِ مَعَ خِبْرَةِ الكِبار.
dialogue.tr: attafiqu maʿa nabīl, fālmawḍūʿu muhimmun jiddan, lkinnanī akhtalifu maʿa salīm; fālmujtamaʿu lā yanhaḍu illā biquwwati sh-shabābi maʿa khibrati l-kibār.
dialogue.en: I agree with Nabil about the importance of the topic and disagree with Salim; society only rises through the strength of youth together with the experience of the old.
dialogue.ur: Main Nabeel se mauzu ki ahmiyat mein mutafiq hoon aur Saleem se ikhtilaf karta hoon; muashra sirf jawanon ki quwwat aur buzurgon ke tajurbe se hi aage barhta hai.

dialogue.ar: لكِنَّهُمْ يَفْرِضونَ عَلَيْنا قَراراتِهِمْ في الدِّراسَةِ وَالعَمَلِ، وَحَتّى في اخْتِيارِ الأَصْدِقاء.
dialogue.tr: lkinnahum yafriḍūna ʿalaynā qarārātihim fī d-dirāsati wālʿamal, waḥattā fī ikhtīri l-aṣdiqāʾ.
dialogue.en: But they impose their decisions on us in study and work, and even in choosing friends.
dialogue.ur: Lekin woh hum par apne faislay thopte hain parhai aur kaam mein, balke dosto ke intikhab mein bhi.

dialogue.ar: لِلآباءِ رَأْيٌ وَلِلأَبْناءِ رَأْيٌ، فَلْيَسْتَمِعْ كُلُّ طَرَفٍ إِلى الآخَرِ وَلْيَحْتَرِمْ رَأْيَه.
dialogue.tr: lilʾābāʾi raʾyun walilʾabnāʾi raʾy, falyastamiʿ kullu ṭarafin ilā l-ʾākhari walyaḥtarim raʾyah.
dialogue.en: Fathers have an opinion and sons have an opinion, so let each side listen to the other and respect its opinion.
dialogue.ur: Walidain ki apni raaye hai aur aulad ki apni, is liye har fareeq doosre ki sune aur us ki raaye ka ehtiram kare.

dialogue.ar: والِدي يَأْمُرُني وَلا يَسْأَلُني، وَلا يَجْلِسُ مَعي لِنَتَحاوَرَ أَبَداً.
dialogue.tr: wālidī yaʾmurunī walā yasʾalunī, walā yajlisu maʿī linataḥāwara abadan.
dialogue.en: My father orders me and does not ask me, and never sits with me to talk things over.
dialogue.ur: Mere walid mujhe hukm dete hain, mujh se poochte nahin, aur kabhi mere saath baith kar baat cheet nahin karte.

dialogue.ar: والِدي يُعامِلُني كَصَديق؛ يُصْغي إِلَيَّ وَيُناقِشُني، وَأَنا أَعْمَلُ بِنَصيحَتِه.
dialogue.tr: wālidī yuʿāmilunī kaṣadīq; yuṣghī ilayya wayunāqishunī, waʾanā aʿmalu binaṣīḥatih.
dialogue.en: My father treats me like a friend; he listens to me and discusses with me, and I act on his advice.
dialogue.ur: Mere walid mere saath dost jaisa sulook karte hain; woh meri sunte hain aur mujh se munaqsha karte hain, aur main un ki nasihat par amal karta hoon.

dialogue.ar: لَيْتَ كُلَّ أَبٍ يَفْعَلُ مِثْلَ والِدِكَ يا وَليد!
dialogue.tr: layta kulla abin yafʿalu mithla wālidika yā walīd!
dialogue.en: If only every father did like your father, Walid!
dialogue.ur: Kaash har walid aap ke walid jaisa karta, Walid!

intro.en: إِنَّ and أَنَّ are particles of emphasis that enter a nominal sentence. The subject after them takes fatḥa (it is called the ism of inna), and the predicate takes ḍamma. Example: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.
intro.ur: إِنَّ aur أَنَّ tawkeed ke huroof hain jo jumla ismiya par aate hain. Un ke baad mubtada mansoob hota hai (ism-e-inna) aur khabar marfoo. Misaal: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.
intro.ar: «إِنَّ» وَ«أَنَّ» حَرْفا تَوْكيدٍ يَدْخُلانِ عَلى الجُمْلَةِ الاِسْمِيَّةِ، فَيُنْصَبُ المُبْتَدَأُ (اِسْمُ إِنَّ) وَيُرْفَعُ الخَبَرُ. مِثالٌ: إِنَّ اللهَ غَفورٌ رَحيمٌ.

q.en: What do إِنَّ and أَنَّ express?
q.ur: إِنَّ aur أَنَّ kya batate hain?

q.en: What case does the noun right after إِنَّ take?
q.ur: إِنَّ ke foran baad wala ism kis haalat mein hota hai?
q.ar: ما حالَةُ الاِسْمِ الَّذي يَأْتي بَعْدَ «إِنَّ» مُباشَرَةً؟

q.en: What case does the predicate (khabar) take?
q.ur: Khabar kis haalat mein hota hai?

q.en: Which sentence uses إِنَّ correctly?
q.ur: Kaun sa jumla إِنَّ sahi istemal karta hai?

intro.en: Practise asking and answering questions with a partner about youth, elders and parents. Compare how two fathers treat their grown sons.
intro.ur: Apne saathi se nojawanon, buzurgon aur walidain ke baare mein sawal jawab ki mashq karein. Do baapon ke apne bare beton se sulook ka muqabla karein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ مَعَ زَميلٍ عَلى طَرْحِ الأَسْئِلَةِ وَالإِجابَةِ عَنِ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ وَالوالِدَيْنِ. قارِنْ بَيْنَ أَبَوَيْنِ في مُعامَلَةِ أَبْنائِهِما الكِبارِ.

q.en: What does «وَحْدَهُمْ» mean in «الشَّبابِ وَحْدَهُمْ»?
q.ur: «وَحْدَهُمْ» ka matlab?

q.en: What does «لِماذا؟» ask for?
q.ur: «لِماذا؟» kya poochta hai?

q.ar: أَبٌ يَسْتَمِعُ وَيَتَحَدَّثُ وَيَحْتَرِمُ الآراءَ يُعامِلُ أَبْناءَهُ كَـ...

q.en: A father who does not listen or talk with his sons treats them like:
q.ur: Jo baap na sunta hai na baat karta hai wo bete se kaisa sulook karta hai:
q.ar: أَبٌ لا يَسْتَمِعُ وَلا يَتَحَدَّثُ مَعَ أَبْنائِهِ يُعامِلُهُمْ كَـ...

intro.en: A reading passage about problems young people face today, such as cultural invasion, feeling a contradiction between home and media, and difficulty finding work or study. It ends by saying society should help solve them.
intro.ur: Ek matn jis mein aaj ke nojawanon ke masail ka zikr hai: saqafati yalghar, ghar aur media ke darmiyan tazad ka ehsaas, aur kaam ya taleem ki dushwari. Aakhir mein kaha gaya ke muashre ko in ke hal mein madad karni chahiye.
intro.ar: نَصٌّ لِلقِراءَةِ عَنْ مُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ اليَوْمَ، مِثْلَ الغَزْوِ الثَّقافِيِّ وَالشُّعورِ بِالتَّناقُضِ بَيْنَ البَيْتِ وَوَسائِلِ الإِعْلامِ وَصُعوبَةِ إيجادِ عَمَلٍ أَوْ دِراسَةٍ. وَيَنْتَهي بِدَعْوَةِ المُجْتَمَعِ إِلى المُساعَدَةِ.

dialogue.ar: لِلشَّبابِ في زَمَنِنا هُمومٌ كَثيرَةٌ، مِنْها ما يُسَمّى الغَزْوَ الثَّقافِيَّ، وَهُوَ فَرْضُ لُغاتٍ وَثَقافاتٍ أَجْنَبِيَّةٍ.
dialogue.tr: lilshshabābi fī zamaninā humūmun kathīrah, minhā mā yusammā l-ghazwa th-thaqāfiyy, wahuwa farḍu lughātin wathaqāfātin ajnabiyyah.
dialogue.en: Young people in our time have many worries, among them what is called cultural invasion, which is imposing foreign languages and cultures.
dialogue.ur: Hamare daur mein nojawanon ke bohat se masail hain, jin mein ghazw-e-saqafi kehlata hai, yaani ghair-mulki zabanon aur saqafaton ko thopna.

dialogue.ar: فَقَدْ بَدَأَ بَعْضُهُمْ يُقَلِّدُ اللُّغاتِ وَالعاداتِ الأَجْنَبِيَّةَ، وَيَنْسى لُغَتَهُ وَتُراثَ أُمَّتِه.
dialogue.tr: faqad badaʾa baʿḍuhum yuqallidu l-lughāti wālʿādāti l-ajnabiyyah, wayansā lughatahu waturātha ummatih.
dialogue.en: Some of them have begun to imitate foreign languages and habits, and forget their own language and the heritage of their nation.
dialogue.ur: Un mein se kuch ghair-mulki zabanon aur adaton ki naqal karne lage hain, aur apni zaban aur apni qaum ki wirasat bhoolne lage hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَتَأَثَّرُ كَثيرونَ بِما تَعْرِضُهُ وَسائِلُ الإِعْلام، فَيَجِدونَ فَرْقاً بَيْنَ ما يَرَوْنَهُ هُناكَ وَما يَتَعَلَّمونَهُ في البَيْتِ وَالمَدْرَسَة.
dialogue.tr: wayataʾaththaru kathīrūna bimā taʿriḍuhu wasāʾilu l-iʿlām, fayajidūna farqan bayna mā yarawnahu hunāka wamā yataʿallamūnahu fī l-bayti wālmadrasah.
dialogue.en: Many are influenced by what the media show, and they find a difference between what they see there and what they learn at home and school.
dialogue.ur: Bohat se log media ki dikhai hui cheezon se mutasir hote hain, aur wahan jo dekhte hain us mein aur ghar aur school ki taleem mein farq paate hain.

dialogue.ar: وَيَشْكو الشَّبابُ مِنْ قِلَّةِ اهْتِمامِ المُجْتَمَعِ بِهِمْ، وَمِنْ صُعوبَةِ الحُصولِ عَلى مَقْعَدٍ في التَّعْليمِ العالي.
dialogue.tr: wayashkū sh-shabābu min qillati ihtimāmi l-mujtamaʿi bihim, wamin ṣuʿūbati l-ḥuṣūli ʿalā maqʿadin fī t-taʿlīmi l-ʿālī.
dialogue.en: Young people complain that society pays little attention to them, and of the difficulty of getting a seat in higher education.
dialogue.ur: Nojawan shikayat karte hain ke muashra un ki taraf kam tawajjo deta hai, aur ke ala taleem mein dakhla milna mushkil hai.

dialogue.ar: وَيَشْكو بَعْضُهُمْ مِنْ قِلَّةِ الوَظائِفِ بَعْدَ أَنْ يَتَخَرَّجوا، وَمِنْ غَلاءِ تَكاليفِ الزَّواج.
dialogue.tr: wayashkū baʿḍuhum min qillati l-waẓāʾifi baʿda an yatakharrajū, wamin ghalāʾi takālīfi z-zawāj.
dialogue.en: Some complain of the scarcity of jobs after they graduate, and of the high costs of marriage.
dialogue.ur: Kuch log is baat ki shikayat karte hain ke taleem mukammal karne ke baad naukriyan kam hain, aur ke shadi ke akhrajat mehnge hain.

dialogue.ar: وَلَيْسَ حَلُّ هذِهِ المُشْكِلاتِ بِاللَّوْم، بَلْ يَجِبُ أَنْ يَعْمَلَ المُجْتَمَعُ مَعَ الشَّبابِ لِيُشارِكوا في بِناءِ الوَطَن.
dialogue.tr: walaysa ḥallu hādhihi l-mushkilāti billlawm, bal yajibu an yaʿmala l-mujtamaʿu maʿa sh-shabābi liyushārikū fī bināʾi l-waṭan.
dialogue.en: The solution to these problems is not blame; rather society must work with the young so that they take part in building the homeland.
dialogue.ur: In masail ka hal malamat nahin, balke muashre ko nojawanon ke saath milkar kaam karna chahiye taake woh watan ki tameer mein hissa len.

q.en: What does «يَشْكو مِنْ» mean?
q.ur: «يَشْكو مِنْ» ka matlab?

intro.en: Pronouns can attach to the end of nouns and prepositions: for 'I/we' (ـي، ـنا), 'you' (ـكَ، ـكِ، ـكُما، ـكُمْ، ـكُنَّ) and 'he/she/they' (ـهُ، ـها، ـهُما، ـهُمْ، ـهُنَّ). Example: كِتابي (my book), قَلَمُكَ (your pen), بَيْتُهُمْ (their house).
intro.ur: Zamair ism aur harf-e-jar ke aakhir mein lag jate hain: mutakallim (ـي، ـنا), mukhatab (ـكَ، ـكِ، ـكُما، ـكُمْ، ـكُنَّ) aur ghaib (ـهُ، ـها، ـهُما، ـهُمْ، ـهُنَّ). Misaal: كِتابي (meri kitab), قَلَمُكَ (aap ka qalam), بَيْتُهُمْ (un ka ghar).
intro.ar: تَتَّصِلُ الضَّمائِرُ بِآخِرِ الأَسْماءِ وَحُروفِ الجَرِّ: لِلمُتَكَلِّمِ (ـي، ـنا) وَلِلمُخاطَبِ (ـكَ، ـكِ، ـكُما، ـكُمْ، ـكُنَّ) وَلِلغائِبِ (ـهُ، ـها، ـهُما، ـهُمْ، ـهُنَّ). مِثالٌ: كِتابي، قَلَمُكَ، بَيْتُهُمْ.

q.en: Which ending means «my» in كِتابي?
q.ur: كِتابي mein «meri» ka ending kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ في «كِتابي» يَدُلُّ عَلى المُتَكَلِّمِ المُفْرَدِ؟

q.en: Which ending means «our» in مَدارِسُنا?
q.ur: مَدارِسُنا mein «hamari» ka ending kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ ضَميرٍ في «مَدارِسُنا» يَدُلُّ عَلى المُتَكَلِّمينَ؟

intro.en: Practise writing: turn the first dialogue into a short story, then write short compositions about youth, about the relationship between youth and elders, and about the problems of youth today.
intro.ur: Likhne ki mashq: pehli guftagu ko chhoti kahani mein badlein, phir nojawani, nojawanon aur buzurgon ke rishte aur aaj ke nojawanon ke masail par chhote mazmoon likhein.
intro.ar: تَدَرَّبْ عَلى الكِتابَةِ: حَوِّلِ الحِوارَ الأَوَّلَ إِلى قِصَّةٍ قَصيرَةٍ، ثُمَّ اُكْتُبْ مَوْضوعاتٍ قَصيرَةً عَنِ الشَّبابِ وَالعَلاقَةِ بَيْنَ الشَّبابِ وَالشُّيوخِ وَمُشْكِلاتِ الشَّبابِ اليَوْمَ.

q.en: Which sentence begins the story about Sami's mother?
q.ur: Sami ki walida ki kahani kis jumle se shuru hoti hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ جُمْلَةٍ تَصْلُحُ بِدايَةً لِقِصَّةِ والِدَةِ سامي؟

options: أَصْبَحَتْ والِدَةُ سامي خائِفَةً عَلى اِبْنِها

q.en: What does «اُكْتُبْ» mean?
q.ur: «اُكْتُبْ» ka matlab?

q.en: What does «مَوْضوع» mean?
q.ur: «مَوْضوع» ka matlab?

q.en: What is one title of the compositions?
q.ur: In mein se ek mazmoon ka unwan kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ عُنْوانٍ يَصْلُحُ لِلتَّعْبيرِ في هذا الدَّرْسِ؟

intro.en: Two small skills: write a line of poetry in the Ruqʿa script, and learn the spelling rule that an extra alif is written after the plural و (واوُ الجَماعَة) in verbs, e.g. صَلّوا.
intro.ur: Do chhoti mahartein: ek sher Ruqa khat mein likhna, aur imla ka qaida: fel mein waw-e-jama'at ke baad alif likha jata hai, jaise صَلّوا.
intro.ar: مَهارَتانِ صَغيرَتانِ: اُكْتُبْ بَيْتَ شِعْرٍ بِخَطِّ الرُّقْعَةِ، وَتَعَلَّمْ قاعِدَةَ الإِمْلاءِ: تُزادُ أَلِفٌ بَعْدَ واوِ الجَماعَةِ في الأَفْعالِ، مِثْلَ «صَلَّوْا».

q.en: When is an extra alif written after و?
q.ur: Kab و ke baad alif likha jata hai?
q.ar: مَتى تُكْتَبُ أَلِفٌ زائِدَةٌ بَعْدَ الواوِ؟

options: After the plural و of verbs (waw of the group)
After any و in a noun
Only at the start of a word

q.en: Which is written correctly?
q.ur: Kaun sa sahi likha hai?

q.en: Which verb needs NO extra alif after و?
q.ur: Kis fel mein و ke baad alif nahin aata?
q.ar: أَيُّ فِعْلٍ لا يَحْتاجُ إِلى أَلِفٍ بَعْدَ الواوِ؟

options: نَدْعو (the و is part of the verb)

q.en: Why is the alif added?
q.ur: Alif kyun barhaya jata hai?

options: To tell the plural و from other waws

intro.en: A review of the grammar, vocabulary and reading from this unit and the previous one: pronouns, weak verbs, definite and indefinite nouns, and building questions from jumbled words.
intro.ur: Is unit aur pichle unit ki grammar, alfaaz aur parhai ki dohrai: zamair, illat wale afaal, nakira marifa aur bikhre alfaaz se sawal banana.
intro.ar: مُراجَعَةٌ لِلقَواعِدِ وَالمُفْرَداتِ وَالقِراءَةِ مِنْ هذِهِ الوِحْدَةِ وَالَّتي قَبْلَها: الضَّمائِرُ وَالأَفْعالُ المُعْتَلَّةُ وَالنَّكِرَةُ وَالمَعْرِفَةُ وَتَكْوينُ الأَسْئِلَةِ مِنْ كَلِماتٍ مُبَعْثَرَةٍ.

q.en: What does the text say grew in European cities in modern times?
q.ur: Matn ke mutabiq jadeed daur mein Europe ke shehron mein kya barha?
q.ar: ماذا قالَ النَّصُّ إِنَّهُ زادَ في المُدُنِ الأُوروبِّيَّةِ حَديثاً؟

options: The number of Islamic centres and mosques

q.en: Which is a correct question from the words: كَيْفَ – أَفْهَمُ – الإِسْلامَ – صَحيحاً – فَهْماً?
q.ur: In alfaaz se sahi sawal kaun sa hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ صَحيحٌ يُكَوَّنُ مِنَ الكَلِماتِ: كَيْفَ – أَفْهَمُ – الإِسْلامَ – صَحيحاً – فَهْماً؟

q.en: Which question asks about Islam being only for Arabs?
q.ur: Kaun sa sawal poochta hai ke Islam sirf Arabon ka hai?
q.ar: أَيُّ سُؤالٍ يَسْأَلُ هَلِ الإِسْلامُ لِلعَرَبِ وَحْدَهُمْ؟

options: هَلْ يَخْتَصُّ الإِسْلامُ بِالعَرَبِ دونَ غَيْرِهِمْ؟

q.en: What does the attached pronoun in «أَسْعَدَنا» mean?
q.ur: «أَسْعَدَنا» mein zameer ka matlab?

q.en: What does «هَلْ» start?
q.ur: «هَلْ» kis tarah ka jumla shuru karta hai?
